bankTransfer.referenceNote: Quote your booking code as the transfer reference.

scenarios.label: Power outage > 12 h
scenarios.trigger: Outage > 6 h at a traveler's accommodation opens a case; > 12 h affecting travelers = major; > 24 h = restructure or early return.

steps.text: Confirm safety and location of every traveler on site
Confirm generator, water and food at each casa
Relocate to accommodation with backup power if outage > 12 h
Offer cash advance for emergency expenses
If > 24 h: restructure itinerary or early return
Document duration and impact

options.title: Stay at the casa with the generator windows
options.detail: Meal vouchers for the remaining dinners · power banks delivered · no change to price

options.title: Move to accommodation with backup power tonight
options.detail: Same price · transfer arranged by the desk

options.title: Swap the remaining days for another region
options.detail: Casa, driver and guide re-booked · any price difference absorbed

options.title: Early return to Havana + credit
options.detail: Pro-rata credit for unused services · hotel with 24 h power

scenarios.policy: Operational disruption: complimentary meal vouchers and a 10–15 % discount on a future booking for outages over 12 h. Full refunds only if services cannot be delivered at all.

scenarios.label: Hurricane
scenarios.trigger: Insmet Hurricane Watch (36–48 h) or Warning (24–36 h) for any province with travelers, or Civil Defense phase 2/3.

steps.text: Activate watch protocol, brief all travelers in the cone
Pre-position water, food, flashlights, power banks at casas
Issue warning with evacuation instructions
Relocate to hotel with backup power or community shelter
Confirm flight status and rebooking options with airlines
Confirm every traveler safe after passage

options.title: Relocate to a Havana hotel with 24 h power now
Shelter in place at the casa (if Civil Defense allows)
options.detail: Supplies pre-positioned · hourly contact · no change to price

options.title: Early return · pro-rata refund + free rebooking
options.detail: Airline rebooking assisted · unused services refunded

scenarios.policy: Force majeure: full refund or free date change within 30 days of departure; during the trip, pro-rata refund for unused services plus rebooking assistance.

scenarios.label: Fuel shortage
scenarios.trigger: Driver cannot confirm fuel 24 h before a transfer, station queues > 2 h, or Viazul route cancellations.

steps.text: Confirm fuel with every transport provider 48 h ahead
Activate backup driver with independent reserve
Consolidate transfers, shift to state operator allotment if needed
Offer itinerary credit for missed activities

options.title: Keep the plan with a standby driver
options.detail: Same times · no change to price

options.title: Shift the transfer by one day, extra night at the casa
Replace the day trip with a local activity

scenarios.policy: Force majeure: itinerary credit for missed services and rebooking at no extra cost; cash refunds case by case.

scenarios.label: Casa closure
scenarios.trigger: Supplier closes, loses its licence or cannot deliver a confirmed stay.

steps.text: Source alternative of equal or higher standard
Communicate options with clear explanation
Re-dispatch stay item, regenerate vouchers
Document closure, update supplier reliability

options.title: Alternative casa · same standard · same price
options.detail: Nearby, equal standard · no change to price

options.title: Cancel the affected nights
options.detail: Full refund of the accommodation portion

scenarios.policy: Lower-quality alternative: rate adjustment or partial refund. No alternative: full refund of the accommodation portion plus a complimentary activity.

scenarios.label: Flight cancellation
scenarios.trigger: Airline cancels an inbound or outbound flight affecting a booking, or a NOTAM on aviation fuel.

steps.text: Notify traveler within 2 h of the cancellation notice
Contact airline for rebooking options
Shift land services by the delay, hold suppliers
Process refund or credit per airline policy

options.title: Shift the whole trip by one day
options.detail: All suppliers re-confirmed · no change to price

options.title: Cancel · full refund of land package

scenarios.policy: Airline cancels with no alternative: full refund of the land package and help with the airline refund claim. If the traveler rebooks, the land package moves at no cost.
